$14.83 increase to annual solid waste assessment
Fee raised from $467.33 to $482.16 per dwelling unit
Fiscal year beginning in October
FCC Environmental Service franchise agreement
novel_facts: No public comment or council discussion before approval
$1.24 per month increase calculation
Maximum rate of $513.70 mentioned
Rising costs for labor, equipment, vehicle maintenance and fuel cited
$24 million settlement with Waste Pro mentioned
November vote on twice-weekly pickup mentioned
material_update_promotion_decisions.reason: Both articles cover the identical City Council action on Monday night approving the same resolution (26-R70) with the same fee increase ($14.83, from $467.33 to $482.16). The incoming article adds contextual details about the lack of discussion, cost justifications, and background about service issues, but these are explanatory details, not material updates that change the core newsworthy fact (the council's approval of the fee increase). The settlement and November vote references are background context, not new developments.
